basis.quote: A set of controller-indexed signatures on an interaction or inception event (delegated or not) MUST at least satisfy the current signing threshold in order for that event to be accepted as valid.
basis.text: Interoperability with keripy 1.x, not conformance: the reading the suite's KERI decision procedure (docs/design.md, KERI) gives a KERI 1.0 body with keripy 1.x's field set, where keri-v1.0.1 would grade the same reading MUST under the quoted sentence. No specification defines the KERI 1.x field sets or the CESR 1.00 attachment codes. keripy 1.2.14 (commit bab95c16e949b61398129a3e41a8f68bad84c94f) is the cross-check (generators/keripy1x_check, generators/DISAGREEMENTS.md).

basis.quote: Events that have a non-empty set of attached signatures which set does not satisfy the REQUIRED thresholds SHOULD escrow the event while waiting for other signatures to arrive either as attachments to the same [[ref: Version]] of the event or to a receipt of that event (see next section).

description: An inception with three keys and signing threshold 2, signed by one key only. A validator must not accept it, and should keep it in case the missing signature arrives (line 1266). Built on keripy 1.x's wire: KERI 1.0 bodies with keripy 1.x's field sets and CESR 1.00 attachments, mirroring KERI-0004 (KS-05) in keri-v1.0.1.
title: keripy 1.x: multi-key inception under its signing threshold
